question: What should HELIOS borrow from predecessor compute systems, what should it avoid, and what combination can HELIOS credibly emphasize as its own product moat?

sources.HELIOS_action: retain hardware adaptation; reject human-observation telemetry
elevate participant sovereignty into a local execution contract
keep explicit resource-class consent and make it auditable

observed_strengths: blocks container workloads when resource conflicts are unresolved
sources.HELIOS_action: treat host pressure as a local throttle/admission signal without observing user content
convert guidance into enforceable local policy while avoiding one universal safe-temperature claim
borrow efficiency/headroom thinking; do not auto-overclock or mining-tune user hardware

observed_strengths: portable temperature and battery primitives where supported

moat_axes.HELIOS_target: local state machine that can tighten or block each execution budget before an approved executor runs

moat_axes.common_elsewhere: resource systems may inspect processes or activity to infer contention
moat_axes.HELIOS_target: hardware-aware / human-blind telemetry contract; no screen, keyboard, mouse, microphone, content or process names
controller can only tighten local policy; local user and Guardian remain final authority

moat_axes.common_elsewhere: safety policy is usually coupled to one compute/mining network
moat_axes.HELIOS_target: same Guardian protects MARKET, SCIENCE, TREASURY, DATA_CENTER, OPERATOR and CUSTOM providers

moat_axes.common_elsewhere: not relevant to conventional compute clients
moat_axes.HELIOS_target: hardware health may change compute budget but can never change RNG, RTP, payout or bonus probability

moat_axes.common_elsewhere: live hardware dashboards depend on local agents
moat_axes.HELIOS_target: browser demo shows policy preview only and refuses to invent temperatures, watts or health claims

credible_emphasis: local hardware sovereignty across replaceable compute providers
strict GAME RNG perpendicular to COMPUTE even when hardware pressure changes
